Story.Title: NASA Exercise: Survival on the Moona
Story.Plot: Scenario: You are a member of a space crew originally scheduled to rendezvous with a mother ship on the lighted surface of the moon. However, due to mechanical difficulties, your ship was forced to land at a spot some 200 miles from the rendezvous point. During reentry and landing, much of the equipment aboard was damaged and, since survival depends on reaching the mother ship, the most critical items available must be chosen for the 200-mile trip. Below are listed the 15 items left intact and undamaged after landing.

Evaluations.Rank: poor -- suggests use of Earth-bound logic
very poor – you’re one of the casualties of the space program!

Item.Name: Two 45 kg tanks of oxygen
Item.Description: Most pressing survival need. Weight is not a factor since gravity is 1/6 of Earth's; each tank would weigh only about 7.5 kg on the Moon.

Item.Name: 20 liters of water
Item.Description: Critical for survival. Needed to replace the massive liquid loss on the illuminated side of the Moon.

Item.Name: Stellar map
Item.Description: Primary means of navigation over the 320 km trip. Star patterns appear essentially identical on the Moon as on Earth..

Item.Name: Food concentrate
Item.Description: Efficient means of supplying energy requirements for the long journey.

Item.Name: Solar-powered FM receiver-transmitter
Item.Description: For communication with the mother ship. Note: FM requires line-of-sight and has a limited range.

Item.Name: 15 meters of nylon rope
Item.Description: Useful for scaling cliffs or tying injured crew members together for safety.

Item.Name: First aid kit (with injection needles)
Item.Description: Needles connected to vials fit special apertures in NASA space suits for medicine/vitamins.

Item.Name: Parachute silk
Item.Description: Used as a shelter to provide protection from the intense solar radiation.

Item.Name: Self-inflating life raft
Item.Description: The CO2 bottle inside the raft may be used as an emergency thruster for propulsion.

Item.Name: Signal flares
Item.Description: Used as a distress signal when the mother ship is within visual range.

Item.Name: Two .45 caliber pistols
Item.Description: Potential use as a means of self-propulsion via the recoil of the shots.

Item.Name: One case of dehydrated milk
Item.Description: A bulkier, less efficient duplication of the food concentrate.

Item.Name: Portable heating unit
Item.Description: Not needed on the lighted side of the Moon. Only useful if traveling on the dark side.

Item.Name: Magnetic compass
Item.Description: Worthless. The magnetic field on the Moon is not polarized; it cannot be used for navigation.

Item.Name: Box of matches
Item.Description: Worthless. There is no oxygen in the lunar atmosphere to sustain combustion.
